verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents its own dunning feature: users can create a dunning notice for an overdue invoice, send it from sevdesk, and manage the stages of their internal dunning process. That covers the reminder half of the story, but only as a manually created notice. Nothing in the pack shows recurring invoices or automatic reminder triggering. Missing for 10: recurring/scheduled invoice setup, automatic (unattended) payment reminders for overdue customers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers

citations.quote: Create a dunning notice for an overdue invoice and send it directly from sevdesk. This feature lets you manage every stage of your internal dunning process.
